Samach Vav Part 226: Two elements in the bittul of creation to the Creator
blurb: Samach Vav p. 185: This bittul of sunlight to the sun consists of two aspects: 1. The light is constantly dependent on its source, and is not an independent entity. 2. The luminary -- besides being utterly superior and of a completely higher caliber of shleimus than its reflection -- is not lacking even the mehus of the reflection's shleimus (the ten sefiros above), being that it is encompassed in the source with even more intensity than its reflection on earth. So too, the bittul of the creation to the Creator consists of two elements: 1. It is constantly dependent on its source, and is not an independent entity. 2. The source is not lacking any of the different elements of shleimus in Aby"a; it all exists in the source as light exists in the luminary.
